reply_text:
I told Dana in her #north-team thread that the deadline for the signed Tamsin Cold Chain order form is 20 November. That comes from Ilse's own post in #north-team on 14 October, which Dana can see.

Nothing posted in the channel since then changes it, and the knowledge base shows only that same note from Ilse. The knowledge base only matches exact words, though, so something worded differently could have been missed.

Ilse didn't give a year, so I said 20 November 2026 would be the next one rather than stating the year as fact. A deadline date isn't a money figure, so it was fine to share in the team channel.
